mapper.sql: cos.id AS id, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT((SELECT description FROM crm_pipeline_settings WHERE is_active = 1 AND id = crm_pipeline_setting_id) SEPARATOR ', ') FROM crm_pipeline_setting_stags WHERE crm_opportunity_stag_id = cos.id) AS pipelineSettingName, cos.name AS stageName, cos.is_apply AS applyWithId, CASE cos.is_apply WHEN 0 THEN '' WHEN 1 THEN 'Quotation' WHEN 2 THEN 'Sales Order' END AS applyWith, cos.created AS created, CONCAT(creator.first_name, ' ', creator.last_name) AS createdBy, cos.modified AS modified, CONCAT(modifier.first_name, ' ', modifier.last_name) AS modifiedBy
FROM crm_opportunity_stags AS cos LEFT JOIN users AS creator ON creator.id = cos.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS modifier ON modifier.id = cos.modified_by

WHERE cos.is_active = 1
AND cos.name LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%")
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_opportunity_stags ( name, created, created_by, is_apply, is_active ) VALUES ( #{stage.name}, NOW(), #{stage.createdBy}, #{stage.applyWith}, #{stage.isActive} )
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_opportunity_stags SET name = #{stage.name}, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{stage.modifiedBy}, is_apply = #{stage.applyWith} WHERE id = #{stage.id} AND is_active = 1
UPDATE crm_opportunity_stags SET is_active = 2, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{userId} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_active = 1
